name: OnionShare
description_en: Securely and anonymously share a file of any size. `GPL-3.0` `Python/deb`
description: Securely and anonymously share files, host websites, and chat with friends using the Tor network
readme_preview:
![OnionShare](/docs/source/_static/logo.png)

OnionShare is an open source tool that lets you securely and anonymously share files, host websites, and chat with friends using the Tor network.

You can download OnionShare for Windows and macOS from the [OnionShare website](https://onionshare.org).
